options: Rs. 3000 fine or imprisonment of three months or both
Rs. 1000 fine or imprisonment of 1 month or both

explain: Registration as a Professional Engineer requires higher educational background, typically specified as Master's degree in Engineering alongside professional practice experience.

options: bacheclor in engg. and 5 years experience
master in engg. and 5 yrs experience
explain: A foreign engineer must possess a minimum of a Bachelor's degree in engineering along with 10 years of professional work experience to register in NEC.

q: 6. In which year (B.S) was the Nepal Engineering Act promulgated?
explain: The Nepal Engineering Council Act was promulgated in 2055 B.S., establishing NEC as an autonomous regulatory body.

q: 7. NEC publishes the name of registered engineers each year as well as every forth year. The name of foreigner engineers publish
explain: The published roster of registered foreign engineers is updated and released annually by the Council.

q: 8. The registered engineers in Nepal Engineering council should have to renew registration in:
explain: NEC registration renewal does not follow a fixed 1/2/4-year cycle under the given options; the actual renewal requirement differs, so 'none of the above' is correct as per the answer key.

q: 9. NEC act and its regulation..........
explain: The NEC Act was promulgated in 2055 BS and the accompanying NEC Regulations were issued in 2057 BS.

q: 10. Nepal engineering council is an autonomous body formed under NEC act in
explain: NEC was legally established as a statutory autonomous body under the Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055 BS.

q: 11. Which of the following category of engineer is not mentioned in engineering Council rule, 2057 for registration?
explain: The NEC Rule 2057 recognizes categories such as General, Professional, and Non-Nepali Registered Engineer, but does not include 'Chartered Engineer' as a registration category.

q: 12. Which of the following category of Engineer is not mentioned in Engineering Council rule
explain: 'Chartered Engineer' is a designation used in foreign systems (like the UK) and is not a formal category under NEC rules.

options: accreditation of certificates of academic qualifications
explain: Granting legal sanction/permission to open academic engineering colleges lies with Universities and Ministry authorities, not NEC direct regulatory mandate.

q: 14. In general, Nepal Engineering Council meeting per year should be held:
explain: As per NEC rules, the Council is required to hold its general meeting four times a year.

q: 15. Which one is not concerned with NEC
options: authority of opening engineering college me
explain: NEC focuses on regulating engineering professional registration and academic recognition rather than granting college establishment permits.

q: 16. NEC does not approach for
explain: NEC does not provide direct upgrading routes from Overseer (Diploma) level to Engineer without obtaining an accredited Bachelor's degree in engineering.

q: 17. What is the provision in Engineer Council Act and Regulation in Nepal for the punishment if a person practices Engineering work without registering into the Nepal Engineering Council?
options: Rs. 3, 000 fine or imprisonment of 3 months or both
Rs. 1, 000 fine or imprisonment of 1 month or both
explain: Under NEC Act provisions, practicing engineering without registration can attract a fine of Rs. 3,000 or imprisonment up to 3 months, or both.

explain: The standard duration of validity for foreign engineering registration under NEC regulations is up to 3 years.

q: 19. Membership categorized by Nepal Engineering Council for registration is
explain: NEC categorizes registered members as General Engineer, Professional Engineer, and Non-Nepali Registered Engineer; 'Professional Engineer' is the correct categorized membership among the options.

explain: Upon employer request, the council can extend/renew foreign engineer registration for a duration not exceeding 1 year at a time.

q: 21. The decision of the Nepal Engineering Council meeting minute is authenticated by
explain: The minutes of NEC meetings are authenticated by the Member Secretary of the Council.

conduct seminars and organize consultations of professional development
explain: NEC's core mandate is to regulate the engineering profession, including exercising disciplinary control over the professional conduct of registered engineers.

options: at least bachelor degree in any engineering subject
at least masters degree in engineering subject
at least Diploma in any engineering subjects
